value.rationale: Exact complete first two period strata for all additive translates of a published infinite permutation-polynomial family. One translate is a fixed-point-free involution with q/2 cycles while every other has no primitive two-cycle; fixed points split by absolute trace. The sharp all-versus-none discontinuity is a structural finite-field dynamical invariant, not a routine reindexing or arbitrary finite slice; the conjugacy also supplies a natural mechanism.
